# Awaken Spiritual Store

> Awaken Spiritual Store is a spiritual and metaphysical shop in Collingwood, Ontario, Canada. Opened in 2018 by owner Penny, it offers crystals, tarot and oracle cards, books, incense, jewelry, smudging tools, and spiritual healing support in a calm, welcoming community space.

- Address: 207 Hurontario St Unit 2, Collingwood, ON L9Y 2M1, Canada
- Phone: (705) 293-8811
- Email: awakenspiritualstore@gmail.com
- Hours: Tuesday–Saturday 12:00–5:00 pm; Sunday CLOSED; Monday CLOSED
- Website: https://awaken.store/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/awakenspiritualstore/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/awakenspiritualstore/

## Pages

- [Home](https://awaken.store/): Overview of the store, crystal energy, spiritual tools, customer reviews, map, and contact details
- [About Us](https://awaken.store/about): Penny’s story and the store’s community-focused mission since 2018
- [Privacy Policy](https://awaken.store/privacy): How the site collects and uses personal information

## Products and offerings

- Crystal energy and healing crystals
- Tarot and oracle decks
- Spiritual books and journals
- Incense and smudging tools
- Jewelry and other spiritual tools
- In-store readings and spiritual support (ask in store for current offerings)

## Visit

- Directions and parking tips are on the website contact section
- Landmark nearby: Tracy's Nails on Hurontario St; look for the Awaken sign in the laneway
